topic: Compare the price of owning a condo vs a hdb vs landed property in diffrent parts of singapore
kindReason: The topic sets three options side by side (HDB, condo, landed) across regions, so the useful output is each option's total cost of owning over a period.
title: Owning an HDB, condo or landed home by region
summary: Compares the total cost of owning an HDB flat, a private condominium and a landed terrace house in central, city-fringe and outer Singapore, in SGD. Assumes a typical unit of each type (4-room HDB, 3-bedroom condo, terrace house), a 25-year home loan, and buyer's stamp duty included.
